svg.title: Sabay Premium Bank: Master Cloud Migration and Modernization Architecture
svg.desc: Comprehensive Architecture: On-premises Linux data center migrating 100,000 synthetic records to a 3-tier AWS VPC in Stockholm. Edge ingress terminates TLS 1.3 on bank.saphigen.com with Cloudflare CNAME and ALB redirect. Compute features EC2 with IMDSv2 and Amazon EKS microservices. Persistence utilizes private RDS PostgreSQL 16.10 with verify-full CA encryption and automated PITR. SRE plane incorporates CloudWatch, SNS email alerts, Systems Manager, Secrets Manager, and cross-region DR in Ireland.
svg.text: SABAY PREMIUM BANK | Core Banking Cloud Migration & Modernization Blueprint
PRIMARY REGION: eu-north-1 (Stockholm) • TARGET DOMAIN: bank.saphigen.com • PROTOCOL: TLS 1.3 • PERSISTENCE: Amazon RDS PostgreSQL 16.10

g.text: Primary Region: AWS eu-north-1 (Stockholm) | Custom Banking VPC (10.0.0.0/16)
Tier 1: Public Ingress Subnets (Dual AZ: eu-north-1a & eu-north-1b)
Port 80: HTTP 301 Redirect • Port 443: HTTPS (TLS 1.3 ELBSecurityPolicy-TLS13-1-2-2021-06) • ACM: bank.saphigen.com
Tier 2: Private Application Compute Subnets (Dual AZ: eu-north-1a & eu-north-1b | Zero Public SSH Ports)
HPA Autoscale (2 to 8 Pods) • Ledger Debits/Credits
Tier 3: Isolated Database Persistence Subnets (Dual AZ | Zero Internet Route)
Single-AZ Instance in Multi-AZ DB Subnet Group across isolated subnets (eu-north-1a & eu-north-1b)
• Storage: 20 GB gp3 SSD • Encryption: AWS KMS Key at Rest • Auto Minor Version Upgrade: Enabled
• Parameter Group: rds.force_ssl = 1 • Client Transport: sslmode=verify-full (RDS CA global-bundle.pem)
• Point-in-Time Recovery: Retention 1 Day • Automated PITR Verified at 452s Duration
Designed Pilot Light (Blocked by SCP p-66jhqpow)
Cross-Cutting Security, Governance & SRE Observability Plane
